briefing: Markets were modestly risk-on today, NASDAQ +1.0% and S&P 500 +0.9%. With one of three open slots deployed into HTFL — the top-scoring candidate showing full institutional-grade signal confirmation — while holding all seven existing positions since none hit stop-loss or profit-target levels.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, on the theory that strength tends to continue in the short term. Today's pick, HTFL, showed five confirming signals together — a bullish MACD crossover, healthy RSI, price above its moving average, and a volume surge — which is stronger evidence than any single signal alone.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能投資是指買入已經處於上升趨勢的股票,理論基礎是短期內強勢股票往往會延續其強勢。今天選中的HTFL同時出現五個確認訊號——MACD黃金交叉、健康的RSI水平、股價高於移動平均線,以及成交量放大——比單一訊號更具說服力。

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices posted modest gains today, with NASDAQ up 1.0% and the S&P 500 up 0.9%, reflecting a mild risk-on tone across equities. No specific news catalysts were provided for today's session, so the move likely reflects continued momentum in growth and tech-adjacent names. Breadth appeared healthy given the number of stocks screening with bullish MACD crossovers and volume surges.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤溫和上揚,納斯達克指數上漲1.0%,標普500指數上漲0.9%,市場呈現溫和的風險偏好情緒。今日並未提供具體新聞催化劑,升勢可能延續了科技及成長股近期的動能。從篩選名單中多檔個股出現MACD黃金交叉及成交量放大來看,市場參與廣度良好。

trades.reasoning: Score 100 with full 5-signal confirmation (MACD bullish crossover, RSI 64.3 in bullish zone, price above SMA-20, rising histogram, volume surge) fits the multi-signal high-conviction setup from strategy memory on this risk-on day.
